messages:
Maya (CS): FYI we just got a high-priority escalation from AcmeMaps — they say search grounding and citations collapsed after yesterday's rollout. customer provided specific queries + request_ids. they say recall dropped ~30% and more hallucinations.
Jules (Support): Ack. Can you paste the sample query + returned doc ids? also need the request_id and timestamp so we can fetch logs.
Maya (CS): customer example: query="nearest EV chargers open now". Request ID: req_2026_03_14_acme_4482. Response had 3 results, only one was relevant and citation link was wrong (pointing to internal docs). They included this snippet:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retrieval/query \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -d '{"index":"acme-maps-v1","query":"nearest EV chargers open now","top_k":5}'
```
Samir (Eng-ML): Thanks. I'm seeing two relevant changes in last rollout notes: (1) reranker moved from dot-product + learned-fusion to an ML-based ranker v2 with a different score normalization; (2) embedding normalization changed (unit-norm enforcement) to improve cosine comparability. Both could affect recall/citation ordering.
Ivan (Eng-Runtime): Deploy bot shows rollout at 2026-03-13T21:35:00Z: canary 10% -> gradual. No infra errors in logs. deploy-bot: canary completed without errors :white_check_mark:.
deploy-bot: roll/2026-03-13/reranker-v2 applied to cluster eu-west-1-canary
Connor (SRE): infra looks fine — latency & token errors unchanged. No spike in 5xx. This is likely model/ML logic not infra. :thinking_face:
Jules (Support): Customer also shared two failing queries with golden doc ids. They repro locally by calling the same endpoint and comparing stored vector hits. They report similarity scores dropped for relevant docs (e.g., was 0.89 -> now 0.72).
Maya (CS): Customer included example where citation link changed to an internal staging URL — that's concerning. Could be reranker scoring unrelated to index content.
Samir (Eng-ML): Quick checklist for repro: 1) fetch dense vectors for the query using current embedding model; 2) run raw vector similarity against their index (top_k raw), 3) run reranker v1 vs v2 on the same candidate set to compare scores. Please attach outputs.
Jules (Support): I've asked customer to dump `top_k=50` raw candidate ids + vector scores and shared S3 link. they uploaded: s3://acme-debug/repro_2026_03_14.tar.gz
Ivan (Eng-Runtime): If reranker v2 changed score normalization, it can demote high-precision docs. Also check if we accidentally switched the feature mix (relevance features vs freshness). I see a recent commit that toggled `use_metadata_boost=true` for v2: commit fd4a9b6.
Samir (Eng-ML): I'm running a quick in-house diff between v1/v2 on a small eval set. Preliminary: v2 increases diversity but lowers exact-match grounding for head queries. Might be a tuning regression.
Aisha (Product): Critical question for triage: do we roll back reranker v2 or push urgent retune? Customer is enterprise with SLA — they want immediate mitigation.
Connor (SRE): Rollback is low-risk from infra side. We need Eng-ML signoff to avoid flip-flopping.
Samir (Eng-ML): I can prepare a fast rollback to reranker v1 for AcmeMaps tenant via routing override. Suggest: apply tenant-scoped policy to route acme-maps -> reranker-v1 and reindex not required. That should restore prior ordering.
Maya (CS): Customer asked for timeline. If we can flip routing for their tenant now, they'll verify within an hour. Please prioritize. :rotating_light:
Ivan (Eng-Runtime): I can push tenant routing override (policy id pr-927) once Eng-ML approves. Need a config diff and a canary to 100% for that tenant.
Samir (Eng-ML): Approve rollback for acme-maps. Also logging action items: 1) run A/B eval between v1/v2 on their query set; 2) check embedding normalization impact; 3) audit `use_metadata_boost` flag and its interaction with reranker features; 4) add regression test for citation URL sanity.
Jules (Support): Noted. I'll update the customer: propose routing flip now, followed by test window.
Maya (CS): I'll send prepared message: "we're routing your tenant to the previous reranker variant immediately and will follow up with detailed repro results and a permanent fix timeline".
Aisha (Product): Also capture business impact and whether this affected billing or data exposure (staging URL). We need postmortem if citation links pointed to internal staging.
Samir (Eng-ML): One more thing — request logs show reranker returned `score_normed` values with a different distribution (mean shifted from 0.72->0.48). That explains more demotion. I'll attach the histogram after I finish the offline eval.
Ivan (Eng-Runtime): Going to push tenant override now for acme-maps to reranker-v1. Will tag rollout in deploy pipeline and notify here when done.
Connor (SRE): Keep me posted — I'll watch request error rates and latency.
deploy-bot: applied routing override pr-927 -> acme-maps: reranker-v1 at 2026-03-14T15:12:03Z
Ivan (Eng-Runtime): Done. Please confirm with the customer.
Maya (CS): Customer confirms: immediate improvement, recall looks back to expected levels, citations correct. They're testing further. :tada:
Samir (Eng-ML): Great. I'll continue the deeper eval and prepare a patch for v2 (re-tune normalization and metadata boost interplay) and a regression smoke test.
Aisha (Product): Thanks team. Please escalate to postmortem if we find the staging URL leak.
Jules (Support): I'll keep monitoring the S3 debug link and customer thread. Closing loop in 24h unless new issues arise. :white_check_mark:
